images.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: coordinated editorial illustration for an Italian university Slidev deck about inventing future AI services, NEXT ME.
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target and supplies ONLY the subject matter. Image 2 is the deck cover and supplies the visual identity ONLY, never copy its words or its whole slide layout.
Primary request: completely redraw image 1 in a bold geometric editorial print style that belongs to image 2. Keep the idea of two students designing useful future services together, with an adaptive object, a miniature domestic ecosystem and an immersive learning space. Keep a landscape composition, about 3:2.
Style/medium: an art-directed Swiss modernist / constructivist educational poster, made of sharp cut-paper shapes and thick metro-map routes. People are abstract geometric figures: circle heads, simple angled arms, flat block bodies, no faces or clothing detail. Objects are distilled graphic symbols, not shaded realistic renderings. Build an original cohesive composition, not the original stock-illustration poses traced with a filter.
Composition: white paper background, generous margins. Two geometric designers flank a shared work surface in the lower half; above them three boldly simplified future-service objects are connected to a central small circular hub with double-line metro routes. The routes have 45-degree turns, circular interchange stations and a narrow white stripe inside the indigo track. The visual should read instantly at small slide size. Restrict to a few large, deliberate shapes; use negative space and asymmetry.
Color palette: solid indigo #432DD7, periwinkle #615FFF, signal yellow #FDC700, very pale lavender #EEECFF, pure white #FFFFFF. Indigo dominates, yellow marks selected objects and stations. Match the chromatic strength and graphic discipline of the deck reference.
Materials: crisp opaque flat ink, clean edges, no visible paper texture.
Constraints: preserve the three service ideas and collaboration theme, change only the visual treatment and arrangement. No text, numbers, letters, logos or watermarks. No gradients, shadows, lighting, 3D volume, perspective UI, soft cartoon faces, decorative foliage, sparkles, generic corporate SaaS illustration, floating thought bubbles or rounded blob backgrounds.

Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: portrait editorial illustration for the NEXT ME university course project, coordinated with the attached geometric illustration and slide cover.
Input images: Image 1 is the original edit target, use it for its subject ONLY. Image 2 is the approved visual family reference: geometric people and indigo/yellow metro paths. Image 3 is the slide deck cover, use it for graphic identity ONLY, do not reproduce typography.
Primary request: entirely redraw the concept-design scene in a crisp geometric Swiss-modernist educational poster style. Preserve two students exploring a service concept together around a small table with geometric prototypes; a pathway leads from their choices into an adaptive future learning environment. Portrait composition, about 4:5.
Style/medium: carefully composed geometric cut-paper graphic, bold opaque shapes, circles, rectangles, angular limbs, thick double-line indigo metro routes with narrow white separators, 45-degree turns and circular interchange nodes. The characters are faceless abstract figures made of a circular head and flat geometric body, like architectural pictograms rather than cartoon people. No detailed hair, clothing seams or outlines.
Composition: white background with air. Two geometric figures on either side of a simple shared tabletop in the lower half, pointing to one yellow triangular prototype among a purple circle and cube. The central selected prototype is linked by a thick metro path to a large architectural doorway in the upper half. Inside the doorway, show a geometric learning space and a central rearrangeable structure, reduced to a few strong flat symbols. The metro path is part of the composition, not extra decoration. Large visual hierarchy, strong asymmetric balance.
Color palette: indigo #432DD7, periwinkle #615FFF, yellow #FDC700, pale lavender #EEECFF and white #FFFFFF only. Indigo and white dominate, one or two yellow selection accents. Crisp, saturated.
Constraints: maintain the concept-selection and adaptive-service idea, change the entire drawing language. No text, letters, digits, logos or watermark. All shapes use FLAT SOLID COLOR: no gradients, gloss, 3D highlights, realistic perspective, cast shadows, facial features, decorative plants, thought bubbles, sparkles or generic corporate-website illustration.

Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: landscape editorial illustration for the NEXT ME university course slide explaining that the project deliverable is a responsive website.
Input images: Image 1 is the original edit target, use it for its subject ONLY. Image 2 defines the new coordinated visual style: faceless geometric people, bold indigo/yellow shapes and metro routes. Image 3 is the slide deck cover: use only its graphic identity, never reproduce the text.
Primary request: completely redraw the scene of a person choosing a future AI-enabled service on a desktop website, with its responsive smartphone version alongside. Preserve the lamp as an example of a personalized service. Landscape framing, about 3:2.
Style: bold geometric Swiss-modernist educational print, deliberately designed negative space, opaque crisp color blocks, simple abstract pictograms. A person on the left has a circle head, geometric torso and angular arm pointing toward the selected lamp. No face, hair detail or clothing outlines. The monitor and phone are reduced graphic silhouettes, no realistic mockup perspective.
Composition: pure white background and generous margins. One large rectangular browser in the center-right, smaller upright smartphone partly alongside it. Both show the same highly geometric indigo/yellow articulated lamp icon. The browser includes just a few rectangular selection controls and a yellow action block, all without words or fake text. A thick double-line metro path with narrow white stripe and 45-degree turns links the person's choice to a yellow selection node in the browser, then to a circular confirmation node on the phone. Integrate the route as the reading direction of the illustration. Keep image readable at small slide size, favor a few strong shapes, remove decorative plants.
Palette: indigo #432DD7, periwinkle #615FFF, signal yellow #FDC700, pale lavender #EEECFF and white #FFFFFF only. Match the previous two geometric illustrations.
Constraints: change style and graphic arrangement, keep responsive website / personalized lamp service / human selection subject. No text, lettering, digits, logos or watermarks. Flat solid color, no gradients, shading, gloss, realistic lighting, 3D rendering, photorealism, cartoon faces, speech bubbles, sparkles, generic SaaS stock illustration.
